headline: Bitcoin and Gold Pare Early Losses as Yen Yields Gains; Oil Holds Near $100
summary: Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil prices near $100 continue to keep inflation risks in focus for global investors.
why: Global macro assets including gold, bitcoin, and crude oil react dynamically to currency fluctuations, Asian equity trends, and persistent inflation anxieties.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Macro risk shifts and currency movements directly influence safe-haven metal valuations.

why_moved: Cross-asset shifts driven by foreign exchange adjustments and high energy commodity prices alter investor risk appetites across global financial markets.
